unsupported: This link may not be supported
auth: This video needs you to be signed in — choose a browser where you're logged in under Browser cookies
unavailable: This video is no longer available
rateLimited: Rate limited by the site — wait a few minutes, then retry
forbidden: The site refused the download — retry; if it keeps happening, update the engine in Settings → General → Updates
diskFull: Free up disk space, then retry
permission: Prism can't write there — pick another download folder in Settings → Downloads → Storage
checksum: The file didn't match its expected checksum — retry, or check the checksum you entered
invalidInput: Check the link and your proxy settings
engineMissing: Prism's downloader is missing — reinstall Prism
busy: Prism is busy — try again in a moment
